name: Audit → Multi-model review → Debate
description: Orchestrator-only lane: audits one surface, dispatches the SAME task to 2-3 free models in parallel for review, then runs a debate to converge. Work routes through worktree-proof internal lanes only.

outcomes.description: Surface, trust boundaries, inputs, abuse cases, intended mitigations are explicit.
2-3 free models review the same scope in parallel; consensus + diff is recorded.
Disagreements between models are debated to a single resolution record.

prerequisites.description: One bounded, non-overlapping fileScope is named before any work.
Current surface behavior and trust boundaries are identified.
prerequisites.check: Identify the target scope and baseline ref before dispatch.

lanes.objective: Map trust boundaries, inputs, identities, abuse cases.
Dispatch SAME task to 2-3 free models (baichat, opencode-go, zenmux) in parallel; compare outputs.
Debate disagreements between models; record single resolution.

qualityGates.description: At least 2 models reviewed; consensus/diff recorded.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop; hand entry to the owner.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Apply destructive data or live account changes during review.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Audit review must not mutate live state.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Preserve the review comparison and resolution notes; abandon unresolved dispute branches without merging.
rescueSteps: Preserve the comparison notes and the exact reviewed scope.
Document the specific disagreement points and unresolved findings.
Mark the lane abandoned if multi-model consensus cannot be reached.
stopConditions: Disagreements involve conflicting security assertions that cannot be validated.
The scope requires modifying untouchable guards or production credentials.
A protected owner confirmation boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Never include credentials, tokens, private paths, or sensitive payloads.
